description: Send store events to Segment automatically
name: Segment

images.title: Copy your Segment write key
images.description: In Segment, open your source's Settings → API Keys and copy the Write Key.

images.title: Connect the app
images.description: Paste the write key in the app settings and pick your Segment region (US unless you arranged EU data residency).

images.title: Choose which events to send
images.description: Tick the store events to forward, grouped by model. Nothing is sent until you select events.

images.title: See events arrive in Segment
images.description: Events arrive in the Segment Debugger as readable names like Account Created, with the record as properties.
